name: RapidTriage core forensics #61-#70 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #61 advanced search fixture assertions

required_assertions: Search output preserves query mode/options, fuzzy/stem/regex support, proximity metadata, hit pointers, verification warnings, and #61 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; broad relevance/false-positive corpus remains commercial blocker.

datasets.name: #62 keyword pack fixture assertions

required_assertions: Keyword-pack outputs preserve built-in inventory, custom JSON support, deduplicated expansion, pack provenance, case-specific warnings, and #62 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; signed pack library and per-case editing UI remain blockers.

datasets.name: #63 IOC/TI fixture assertions

required_assertions: Indicator output preserves source links, local rule matches, offline feed provenance, match mode, local-only warning, and #63 core_accuracy_gates.
